notes.title: 《Just Ride：Apparent Horizon 狂飙：极限视界》Full Release Version is Ready
notes.notes: The full release version of <Just Ride> was released. After nearly a year of EA testing, the game has been polished and adjusted to a large extent. We have finally completed all the development content and are ready to go live. There are a lot new idea that never been seen in other games.  For a racing game mixing RPG survival gameplay is cool, you can feel a completely different experience. you can either stroll on the road or go to the wild to play with the wolf, but also up to the sky, the grand map size gives us a big playground. We have overcome many difficulties in this process. A small team has developed huge game content and tried our best to be satisfied in all aspects. Although it was very difficult, it finally achieved this goal. The joy brought by this game is beyond our imagination. Many unexpected surprises are not designed, but the result of conflict of code in game. It is very random and very surprises. I hope everyone can like it. Of course, there are a lot of polished places in the game, and we will continue to improve in the follow-up updates. This is just the beginning. . .
